summary: A school board meeting draws more than 200 people and is moved to a larger room.
realLife: A school district moved a board meeting to a high school library after over 200 people showed up, spilling out; more than 25 spoke and it ran four hours.
sources: Patch, Mehlville school board meeting moved for crowd: https://patch.com/missouri/mehlville-oakville/mehlville-school-board-meeting-moves-to-hs-library-to3981ed913a
